name: wait-released
about: The waiting stage (docs/decisions/2026-10-22-waiting-stage.md). b is built and queued for review, but its review needs a's fix merged first: the user parks it (loop wait --on a). It moves to the Waiting column with what it waits on, its thread says so, and the runner never claims it while a goes through build, review and land. When a is done, loopd moves b back to review with a note in its thread, and the runner claims it for review.
